target_customer: Personal injury and mass tort law firms, plus accident victims who are matched with partner firms
problem: Injury claim intake, medical record gathering and attorney matching are slow and costly. Wayco runs 24/7 AI intake and builds the case file from first call to settlement.
business_model: Lead and case referral to partner law firms (participating attorneys pay), plus AI intake for firms
product_category: AI operator for medical legal cases and legal intake

founders.name: Iqbol Temirkhojaev
previous_startups: Says his first VC-backed startup was at 13 and was acquired by the United Nations at 14 (self-reported on YC page, company not named)
founders.background_notes: Grew up in Khujand, Tajikistan; first Tajik founder in YC per press. Education not stated in sources opened. Solo founder per YC page.

investors: Angels from ElevenLabs, Groq and Gamma

competitors.name: Supio
competitors.what: Agentic legal AI for personal injury and mass tort plaintiff firms
competitors.traction_then: Established, per a vendor comparison page
competitors.funding_then: About 91M per a vendor run comparison page, unverified

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agent intake, record analysis and routing are standard LLM engineering, with legal advertising compliance as the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Attorney and provider relationships may build, but intake tools are copyable and Supio and others are better funded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Intake and client acquisition costs in personal injury law are high; the founder pitch targets 24/7 intake in English and Spanish. Direct demand evidence beyond the pitch was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses wayco.ai; consumer brand CaseHelp uses casehelp.org; dates not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Reassuring: no win, no fee, 0 upfront

branding.brand_signature: Two brand structure: Wayco as the company and CaseHelp as the consumer brand
branding.community_and_virality: Press interest in the founder story in Kazakh and Russian language media (January 2026); no merch or community evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand evidence; the founder story drew regional press but the brand itself did not.

outcome_analysis: Wayco is a five person Winter 2026 company founded by a 19 year old solo founder that raised a pre-seed in January 2026 per press. It is too early for an outcome and no shutdown or acquisition news was found. Legal advertising rules, attorney supply and better funded rivals such as Supio are the main risks.
notes: Funding conflict: the Kazakh press article (January 2026) reports 1.5M pre-seed at 15M valuation, YesPress also says about 1.5M, while VCBacked and Stanford CodeX list 500K and Preqin an undisclosed seed from YC and Pioneer Fund. Recorded the press figure; investor list partly from VCBacked (Pioneer Fund, Outsized Ventures) is unverified and not included. Stage label pre_seed is the article's. Supio funding is from a vendor comparison page.
